description: This class provides a service for importing books from LibraryThing into the application. It converts imported data into Book objects and saves them via BookService.

classes.name: LibraryThingBookImportService
classes.description: Service class responsible for importing books from LibraryThing, converting, and persisting them.

methods.name: importBooksFrom
methods.description: Imports a list of books from LibraryThing, converts them to Book objects, saves each, and returns the list of saved books.
